C0733.title: Meizhou Jiaoling Police Dismantle Hacker Ring: Insider-Outsider Collusion to Illegally Obtain Data
C0733.summary: In December 2020, a Meizhou-based group reported that its procurement bidding platform had been illegally accessed. Investigation revealed that from November 2018 to December 2020, employee Xu colluded with former engineer Tian and supplier Peng.
